name: Ultimate Car Racing VR
summary:
Ultimate Car Racing: The Definitive VR Speed Experience
Step into the cockpit and feel the G-force. Ultimate Car Racing is a high-performance VR racing simulator built from the ground up for Meta Horizon OS. Whether you're a seasoned sim-racer or a casual driver looking for an adrenaline rush, our realistic physics and immersive environments deliver the most authentic car racing experience in virtual reality.
